SELECT d.dept_idx AS deptIdx, d.upper_dept_idx AS upperDeptIdx, d.dept_nm AS deptNm, d.dept_level AS deptLevel,
d.sort_order CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)
AS sortOrder FROM dept_mst d
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.upper_dept_idx, 0), d.dept_level NULLS FIRST, d.sort_order NULLS LAST, d.dept_idx
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.upper_dept_idx, 0), d.dept_level NULLS FIRST, d.dept_idx

SELECT d.dept_idx AS deptIdx, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_mst u WHERE u.dept_idx IN ( WITH RECURSIVE sub_depts AS ( SELECT dept_idx FROM dept_mst WHERE dept_idx = d.dept_idx UNION SELECT m.dept_idx FROM dept_mst m JOIN sub_depts s ON m.upper_dept_idx = s.dept_idx ) SELECT dept_idx FROM sub_depts ) ) AS userCount FROM dept_mst d
SELECT dept_idx AS deptIdx, MIN(${nameColumn}) AS managerNm FROM ${tableName} WHERE dept_idx IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(COALESCE(${managerColumn}::text, 'N')) IN ('Y', 'TRUE', '1') GROUP BY dept_idx
